scenario.quote: Name: Return dishware from dining table to sink

other.Name: Return dishware from dining table to sink

objects.name: Dishes
objects.role: items to be returned to the sink

starting_state.fact: Dishware (plates, bowls, cutlery/utensils) are the items involved.
Items are randomly placed on the dining table in varied positions and orientations.
starting_state.quote: Position: Randomly placed on the dining table in varied positions and orientations.

steps.text: Walk to the table and stand still for 1 second.
steps.quote: 1. Walk to the table and stand still for 1 second.

steps.text: Start with arms in a neutral position. Pick up 1 plate or bowl at a time (gather 2–3 utensils together).
steps.quote: 2. Start with arms in a neutral position. Pick up 1 plate or bowl at a time (gather 2–3 utensils together).

steps.text: Walk to the sink and stop for 1 second.
steps.quote: 3. Walk to the sink and stop for 1 second.

steps.text: Lower the item flat into the sink basin. Return arms to a neutral position.
steps.quote: 4. Lower the item flat into the sink basin. Return arms to a neutral position.

steps.text: Repeat for each dish; group 2–3 utensils in one hand between trips.
steps.quote: 5. Repeat for each dish; group 2–3 utensils in one hand between trips.

repeat.unit: each dish; group 2–3 utensils in one hand
repeat.end_condition: all dishes have been returned to the sink
repeat.quote: Repeat for each dish; group 2–3 utensils in one hand between trips.

acceptance.criterion: The item is lowered flat into the sink basin.
Arms are returned to a neutral position.
acceptance.quote: Return arms to a neutral position.

constraints.rule: Do not rush — place items carefully into the sink.
constraints.violation_looks_like: The person moves hastily, throwing, dropping, or slamming items carelessly into the sink.
constraints.quote: Constraints / Avoid: Do not rush — place items carefully into the sink.

not_modelled.reason: Instruction for resetting the data collection setup between episodes.
not_modelled.quote: Reset: Randomize placement, number, and type of dishware after each episode.
Diversity: Vary the number of items.
Switch between plates, bowls, and silverware.
Alternate using your left or right hand to pick items up.
Change item positions and table settings.
